svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of foreign aid spent domestically within donor countries 2024
Net official development assistance (ODA) that stays in donor countries, as a share of total ODA.

tspan.tspan: Administrative costs represent only expenses not already included as integral parts of other ODA delivery. While some costs (like

text.tspan: diplomatic staff) are spent within recipient countries, they don't reach the intended aid beneficiaries. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the
value from the closest year between 2019 and 2023 is shown instead.
